help.title: Help
faq.apply.q: How do I apply for a job?
faq.apply.a: Create a candidate account, verify your email, complete the required profile fields, then press “Apply” on a job. You can follow the status in your account.
faq.verify.q: Why do I need to verify my email?
faq.verify.a: We send a 6-digit code that expires after a few minutes. It proves the address is yours and protects your account.
faq.approval.a: An administrator reviews some accounts before they can use all features. Meanwhile you can finish your profile and see your status.
faq.data.q: What happens to my personal data?
faq.data.a: You can withdraw optional consents and request an export or deletion of your data in Privacy settings. The full privacy policy is pending publication.
faq.visa.q: Does a job include a work permit or visa?
faq.visa.a: Only if the employer states it on the job page. We never assume visa support from your nationality or location, and we cannot guarantee any visa decision.
